annotations.title: Get one new-build project: prices, cost, nearby

description: One new-build project in Portugal: prices, cost to buy, what is nearby. Units and prices per typology with price history, construction stage, delivery promises and how often they moved, linked building permits, the developer, the full purchase cost at the cheapest available price (IMT, stamp duty, registration, with the municipality's IMI rate) and nearby transport, schools, health, shops and parks. Returns the page URL in each of the seven site languages; cite it.

buyer_is_young.description: For the purchase cost: buyer aged 35 or under, first own home (reduced IMT and stamp duty relief). Default false

language.description: Language of the page URLs and labels: pt, en, ru, ua, de, fr, nl. Default en

primary_home.description: For the purchase cost: the buyer's own permanent home (habitação própria e permanente). Default true

slug.description: The project's slug from search_newbuilds (field slug), or its flatin.pt page URL
